body.name: balanced six-unit margin instance
body.construction: Set \(n_0=6\), \(K=3\), \(m=(1,2,4)\), and \(\mu_0=1/2\). For \(z\in\mathcal S_1\cup\mathcal S_2\cup\mathcal S_3\), set \(f_{z,0}=f_{z,1}=1/2\) and \(f_{z,w}=0\) for \(w\notin\{0,1\}\); for every remaining \(z\in Zspace\), set \(f_{z,0}=1\) and \(f_{z,w}=0\) for \(w\ne0\).
